info.title: Caravel.Bosun
info.description: Bosun CLI for the Clinimatix Caravel framework.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Bosun — CLI for the Clinimatix Caravel framework

commands.name: new
commands.description: Create a Razor or API application in a new directory; does not restore packages.

options.name: --framework-source
options.description: Framework checkout root; use project references before package publication.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Application directory name (letters, digits, underscore; starts with a letter).

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Run the application using dotnet run and its launch profile.

options.name: --project
options.description: Application .csproj or directory (defaults to the current directory).

options.name: --watch
options.description: Restart with dotnet watch on file changes. [default: False]

commands.name: dev
commands.description: Watch a web application and optionally supervise one explicit worker; stop with Ctrl+C.

options.name: --project
options.description: Web application .csproj or directory (defaults to the current directory).

options.name: --worker
options.description: Optional worker .csproj or directory; the application owns its worker and scheduler registration.

commands.name: route:list
commands.description: Inspect endpoints via ExportCaravelRoutesAsync; executes application startup code without starting the host.

options.name: --json
options.description: Output route metadata as JSON. [default: False]

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Read-only SDK and optional development dependency diagnostics.

commands.name: version
commands.description: Print the installed Clinimatix Caravel Bosun version.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Describe the implemented command surface as JSON.

options.name: --json
options.description: Output machine-readable JSON (the only schema format). [default: False]

commands.name: make:model
commands.description: Create a model source file without overwriting existing files.

commands.name: make:seeder
commands.description: Create a seeder source file without overwriting existing files.

commands.name: make:factory
commands.description: Create a factory source file without overwriting existing files.

options.name: --model
options.description: Fully qualified model type, such as App.Models.User.

commands.name: make:job
commands.description: Create a job source file without overwriting existing files.

commands.name: make:event
commands.description: Create a event source file without overwriting existing files.

commands.name: make:listener
commands.description: Create a listener source file without overwriting existing files.

options.name: --event
options.description: Fully qualified event type, such as App.Events.ReportReady.

commands.name: make:migration
commands.description: Create an EF migration under Database/Migrations.

options.name: --context
options.description: DbContext type name; required when EF finds multiple contexts.

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Migration name/ID; rollback also accepts 0 (before the first migration).

commands.name: migrate
commands.description: Apply all pending EF migrations to the configured database.

options.name: --context
options.description: DbContext type name; required when EF finds multiple contexts.

commands.name: migrate:status
commands.description: List EF migrations and their applied status.

options.name: --context
options.description: DbContext type name; required when EF finds multiple contexts.

options.name: --json
options.description: Use EF tooling's native JSON output. [default: False]

options.name: --no-connect
options.description: List migration source without connecting to the database. [default: False]

commands.name: migrate:rollback
commands.description: Migrate to an explicit earlier target; permanently destructive; requires --force.

options.name: --context
options.description: DbContext type name; required when EF finds multiple contexts.

options.name: --force
options.description: Explicitly authorize permanent data loss in the configured database. [default: False]

arguments.name: TARGET
arguments.description: Migration name/ID; rollback also accepts 0 (before the first migration).

commands.name: migrate:fresh
commands.description: Drop the configured database and apply migrations; permanently destructive; requires --force.

options.name: --context
options.description: DbContext type name; required when EF finds multiple contexts.

options.name: --force
options.description: Explicitly authorize permanent data loss in the configured database. [default: False]

commands.name: db:seed
commands.description: Run the application's explicitly registered Clarion database seeders.

options.name: --project
options.description: Application .csproj or directory with RunCaravelSeedersAsync(args) hook.

options.name: --seeder
options.description: Registered seeder simple or fully qualified name; default runs all in registration order.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Maximum seconds before canceling the application (1–86400). [default: 300]
